Class Typefaces

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.typeface.Typefaces
public final class Typefaces extends Object
Loads and selects client typefaces without changing the meaning of effect registrations.

Call from the Minecraft client thread. Drawing also requires the current OpenGL context. Use the Minecraft font renderer inside a selection scope so its drawing, width, trimming and wrapping methods use the same font. Typical GUI code uses with(TypefaceSelection) in try-with-resources and then calls the renderer as usual.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public static Typefaces.Registration register(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation id) throws IOException
      Registers an additional pack family even if the pack omits the shared index. Its descriptor must exist under the ID's namespace and its fallback IDs must already be indexed or registered. Loading is synchronous. After a replacement, closing the old receipt does not remove the new owner.
      Parameters:
      id - descriptor's namespaced family ID
      Returns:
      receipt to close when the registration is no longer needed
      Throws:
      IOException - if the resource is missing or invalid
